RAZORPAY.label: Razorpay
RAZORPAY.desc: Cards, UPI, net banking and wallets. Fee payment links and checkout in the parent app.

webhookSecret.label: Webhook secret
webhookSecret.hint: The secret you typed when adding the webhook in the Razorpay dashboard.

MESSAGING.label: Delivery reports
MESSAGING.desc: Receives delivery and read receipts from the SMS and WhatsApp providers.

metaVerifyToken.label: Meta webhook verify token
metaVerifyToken.hint: Any long random text; type the same in the Meta app’s webhook setup.

bits.secretSaved: Saved (ends {{last4}}). Leave blank to keep it.
bits.copyNow: Copy it now. It is stored only as a hash (or encrypted) and will not be shown again.
bits.liveWarning: Live mode uses real money and real family data. Test in sandbox first.

messaging.msg91Subtitle: MSG91 posts delivery reports to this address. Add it in MSG91 › Settings › Delivery report webhook.
messaging.reportUrlHint: The random part of the address is the password — keep it private.
messaging.waSubtitle: Meta sends sent / delivered / read / failed for every message. Meta app › WhatsApp › Configuration › Webhook.
messaging.subscribeNote: Subscribe the webhook to the messages field. Every call is checked against the app secret (X-Hub-Signature-256); calls that don’t match are refused and logged.
messaging.notCloudApi: WhatsApp isn’t sent with the Cloud API
messaging.title: SMS & WhatsApp
messaging.subtitle: How family messages are sent — MSG91 or any SMS gateway, the WhatsApp Cloud API, SMTP email — and what the providers report back.
messaging.sameSettings: The same settings as Administration › <link>Notification rules</link> › Delivery. What each event says, and the {{sms}} DLT template ids, are set there.
messaging.noUrlsYet: The delivery-report addresses haven’t been made yet. Make them, then paste them into MSG91 and the Meta app.
messaging.templatesNote: Which approved template each family message goes out with — the SMS DLT template id and the WhatsApp template name. Change them in Administration › <link>Notification rules</link>.
messaging.missingTemplates_one: {{count}} message is switched on without the template its provider needs — it won’t be delivered.
messaging.missingTemplates_other: {{count}} messages are switched on without the template their provider needs — they won’t be delivered.
messaging.noTemplates: No family messages for the modules switched on
messaging.noSendsHint: Messages to families appear here once they are sent, with what the provider reported back.

payments.title: Payment gateway
payments.subtitle: The institution’s own Razorpay account: keys, test or live mode, the webhook and how it is doing. Families pay into it from the app and from payment links.
payments.webhookHint: Razorpay dashboard › Account & Settings › Webhooks › Add new webhook: paste this URL, type a secret and save the same secret above.
payments.noWebhooksHint: Razorpay calls this institution’s webhook URL when a family pays, a link expires or a refund is processed.

devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: Biometric and face devices for staff attendance, RFID card readers at the gate and on the bus, and bus GPS trackers. Each device pushes with its own key.
devices.name: Name
devices.namePlaceholder: e.g. Main gate reader, Staff room biometric
devices.serialGpsHint: The tracker’s IMEI or id, for your records.
devices.autoMark: Mark students present from the gate
devices.autoMarkHint: With attendance taken once a day: a child’s first card IN before the “mark by” time marks them present in today’s register (an unmarked or absent child only). The class teacher still opens and saves the register — a device never starts one.
devices.staffNote: Punches are matched by employee code. The first IN of the day is the in time, the last OUT the out time, in Staff & HR › Staff attendance (late after the HR setting). Approved leave isn’t touched.
devices.studentsNote: Punches are matched by the student’s card code or admission number and kept in the punch log (gate and bus).
devices.emptyHint: Register a biometric or RFID device to get its key. It then posts punches to {{url}}
devices.endpointHint: The device (or the small bridge next to it) posts JSON here; the last part is the device’s own key, shown once when it was registered.
devices.formatStaff: code = employee code · at = ISO 8601 time (a time without a zone is read on the institution’s clock) · direction = IN or OUT (optional). Up to 500 a call; re-sending a punch adds nothing.
devices.formatStudents: code = card code or admission number · at = ISO 8601 time · direction = IN or OUT (optional). Up to 500 a call; re-sending a punch adds nothing.
devices.formatGps: lat, lng, speed (km/h), heading and at (ISO 8601). Positions go to the bus this tracker is on (Transport).
devices.newKeyMsg: The old key stops working at once. Put the new key into the device straight away.
devices.putKey: Set this address in the device or its bridge. Keep it private — anyone with it can post punches as this device.
devices.disabled: Device switched off — its key is refused until it is switched on again.
devices.removeMsg: Its key stops working. The punches it already sent stay in the punch log.
devices.neverNote: This device hasn’t called in yet. Set the push address with its key in the device, or send a test punch to check the set-up here.
devices.testHint: Runs the device’s path end to end — the code, the time, the direction — and shows what would happen. Attendance and the gate log are not changed.
devices.testGpsHint: Checks a position for the tracker’s bus. The bus’s position is not changed.
devices.testOk: The device’s punch would be accepted:
devices.noPunchesToday: No punches from this device today.
devices.noPunchesHint: Punches from biometric and RFID devices appear here as they arrive.
devices.gpsNote: Bus GPS trackers are set on the vehicle in Transport › Vehicles (the tracker id / IMEI) and post to the address below, or register a tracker here as a device of kind “Bus GPS tracker” to give it its own key.
devices.gpsUrlHint: Generic JSON { deviceId, lat, lng, speed, at }, or the OsmAnd / Traccar Client protocol most trackers speak (?id=&lat=&lon=&timestamp=).
devices.noTrackers: No bus has a GPS tracker
devices.noTrackersHint: Add the tracker’s id to the vehicle in Transport › Vehicles.

logs.title: Integration logs
logs.subtitle: Every call to and from the payment gateway, SMS and WhatsApp providers, devices, bus GPS and outbound webhooks — and how each provider is doing today.
logs.noErrors: No errors in the last 7 days.
logs.redactedNote: Only an outline of each call is kept: secrets, one-time codes and family contact details are masked. Entries are deleted after {{days}} days.
logs.emptyHint: Calls appear here as soon as a provider, device or webhook is used.
logs.outlineHint: Masked: secrets, codes and contact details never reach the log.
